protocol: Fixed candidates and lexicographic macro means; holdout never selects weights

robustness.protocol: Predeclared sensitivity ±10/20% and ablations; independent audit of every run. Holdout is diagnostic, never tunes weights.
robustness.renaming: Holdout uses renamed providers; responses can differ because simulation hashes provider names.
robustness.conclusion: Веса сохранены. Устойчивость локальных изменений оценивается по summaries; default не объявляется лучшим. Средние Pareto и попарное доминирование всех holdout-сценариев приведены отдельно.

strategy_comparison.protocol: Same input, config, history and operation/provider random outcomes; no catalog overrides; independent semantic audit of every run
